chunks: Who provided them against destitution and gave them security against fear.

key_terms.آمَنَهُمْ: He made them safe / gave them security
key_terms.أَطْعَمَهُمْ: He fed them / provided them with food

ai.seo_question: What are the two main blessings mentioned for the Quraysh in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the stability of the Kaaba and the trade caravans, reflecting the political and economic security granted to the Quraysh as a precursor to the Prophet's mission. It underscores the concept of 'Aman' (security) not merely as physical safety but as a divine covenant that facilitated the spread of Islam from Mecca.
